name: John Harlin
prior_offices: Natrona County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; Oil City News reported he was unopposed for his second elected term)
background: John Harlin is the Natrona County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that he was unopposed for his second elected term. He won the November 2022 general election.
